                         PLAINTIFF'S MOTION FOR LEAVE TO FILE
                        SUPPLEMENTAL COMPLAINT PURSUANT TO
                        FEDERAL RULE OF CIVIL PROCEDURE 15(d)


         Plaintiff Marvelle J. Ballentine, pursuant to Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 15(d), moves

  for leave to file the Proposed Supplemental Complaint attached as Exhibit A. Exhibit A

  supplements Counts III and IV of the First Amended Complaint only; alleges events occurring

  after the First Amended Complaint was filed; adds no defendant; adds no cause of action; adds no

  category of relief; and otherwise leaves the First Amended Complaint unchanged.

         The Proposed Supplemental Complaint pleads three post-filing events: NCMEC's August

  12, 2026 memorandum in support of its motion to dismiss (ECF No. 11); the August 13, 2026

  communication by counsel for NCMEC and Hall; and the August 13, 2026 consolidated motion to

  dismiss filed jointly by Meta Platforms, Inc., Accenture LLP, Genpact Limited, and TaskUs, Inc. in

Case 1:26-cv-02331-RDA-IDD           Document 26       Filed 08/21/26      Page 2 of 4 PageID# 299




  Ballentine v. Meta Platforms, Inc., No. 3:26-cv-05939-RFL (N.D. Cal.), ECF No. 152. The

  NCMEC and Hall events supplement Count III. The Meta event supplements Count IV.

         The grounds for this Motion are set forth in the accompanying Memorandum in Support.

         Pursuant to Local Civil Rule 7(E), Plaintiff states as follows: Plaintiff and counsel for

  NCMEC conferred by telephone on August 20, 2026 regarding this Motion. NCMEC did not

  consent to the relief requested. Defendants Katie Hall and Meta Platforms, Inc. have not appeared

  in this action, and no counsel of record has entered an appearance on their behalf.

         WHEREFORE, Plaintiff respectfully requests that the Court grant leave to file Exhibit A as

  Plaintiff's Supplemental Complaint under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 15(d), and grant such

  other relief as the Court deems just.




  Date: August 20, 2026                                                      Respectfully submitted,
